speaker: thomas_pope
text: She laughed. Once. Aloud, from deep in the chest, and it was at Armado. I am not asking her for a second.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is the review, George said so at dinner, and once is what you had. I went in first. I did not look at the state. The white staff was by it, and the chair was still.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou sawest it the whole time, which is what we said. Paper crown, old velvet, and the line as it is written. I heard no improvement. Good.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Costard said what is set down. And three lines over, to her face. Her hand lifted. I was told not to. I did. The hand is the notice I got.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I heard the three. I am not praising them. I am saying the other thing. She kept her seat to the songs. That's as good as a purse, and likelier.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Likelier is not a sum. I am not entering one. Not tonight, and not as if a likeness had been paid.

speaker: john_sincler
text: I came on in black, at the last. The hall went quiet. It stayed quiet through the owl, Tu-whit to-who, until the chair stirred. I did not make the quiet. I walked into it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: She was in the chair. It was not the empty one. About ten, and also nine. I heard a laugh, which is the answer you said was the one worth having.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then thou hast it. I am not mending the hour after the fact. A laugh is not a clock.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nick held. Under the note, and no heroics in a room where a whisper carries. Thou mayst thank Augustine in the morning. Not here.

speaker: george_bryan
text: That was the word. There was no word. Drink the cup you have. Do not invent a sentence to put in his mouth.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will not invent him a sentence. I will keep the hand, and I will hear about the three lines at some later table, and not from a yeoman.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: One laugh. I can live at a table with one laugh. I have eaten Christmas on less.

speaker: john_sincler
text: The rushes were sweet-flag. A hundred tapers over them, and not one of those tapers was mine. I am not walking the quiet a second time to improve it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The crown was paper when it came off his head. I saw it in a hand, not on the chair. The chair had its own state, and it did not need our gilt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It came off in the passage. I am not carrying a paper crown to the inn as a trophy, and I am not carrying the velvet as one either.

speaker: george_bryan
text: John is not in this room. The book is not in this room. A likeness can wait for the man who writes the money. It will not be written on a cup.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I bowed in the room. Not from the door. She was in the chair. I did not look up to be seen doing it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then the practice held. Leave Jack's owl where the hall left it. A second telling will not make the quiet larger.

speaker: will_kemp
text: One cup. The hand was the notice. I am not owed a second cup for having taken it, and I know a wage when I am not holding one.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Once was the hall. This is a buttery. I am done being the man in black for tonight.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then we are done. The two hours stood in the morning. The laugh stood at night. Carry them, and do not invent a third.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I have both hours, and one laugh. I am not asking for a third thing off her.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Keep them. The laugh is mine to remember, and it is not mine to lend.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God keep you. No purse, no line in a book, and a shoulder that will feel the clap in the morning. I am for the inn when the door lets me, and I am not richer.
